detail.body:
### What does this PR do?

Megatron's `optimizer_cpu_offload=True` turns the optimizer into a **HybridDeviceOptimizer (HDO)**: it permanently splits optimizer state between CPU memory and GPU memory via `optimizer_offload_fraction`. The GPU-side state is owned by a fused CUDA optimizer that can only work with GPU tensors, so it must stay on GPU.

veRL's phase-switch helper (`offload_megatron_optimizer`) moves optimizer state to CPU to free memory. That is correct for a normal optimizer, but for an HDO it also moved the GPU-resident state to CPU — both unnecessary (that state is deliberately GPU-resident) and fatal: the next training step crashes, or the offload itself raises `CUDA error: invalid argument` when the moved tensor points into memory the model offload has already freed (issue #8237).

**Fix**: the offload helper now skips HDO optimizers entirely. Nothing is lost — the HDO's CPU-side state is already on CPU, and the GPU-side state stays where the user asked it to be. Normal optimizers are offloaded exactly as before, and `load_megatron_optimizer` is unchanged.

Adds a regression test (`tests/utils/megatron/test_optimizer_offload_and_load.py`) that builds an HDO (fraction 0.5 and 0.0), steps once, and asserts offload does not move the GPU-side state and load restores it.

### Checklist Before Starting

- [x] Search for similar PRs:
  - https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=8237+in%3Abody
  - https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=optimizer+offload
  - https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=HybridDeviceOptimizer
  - No open PR targets this exact failure. #8235 (same reporter) fixes the *resume* path (`load_checkpoint` with an offloaded optimizer) — different symptom and code path, complementary. #5651 is a feature (offload fp32 master weights), not a fix for this crash, though it touches the same helpers.
- [x] Format the PR title as `[{modules}] {type}: {description}`

### Test

- **Mechanism repro** (standalone, RTX 4090): real HDO + fused GPU optimizer + a state tensor whose backing storage is freed by the model offload, mirroring the reporter's scenario — without the fix it fails with `CUDA error: invalid argument` inside `offload_megatron_optimizer`; with the fix it passes.
- **Unit** (RTX 4090): `pytest tests/utils/megatron/test_optimizer_offload_and_load.py -k "hdo or precision_aware"` → **2 passed**. The existing non-HDO offload test (`-k precision_aware`) passes — no regression. The new HDO regression test (`-k hdo`) passes for fractions 0.5 and 0.0: the GPU sub-optimizer's `exp_avg`/`exp_avg_sq` remain object-identical on cuda across offload and are restored by load.
- **E2E smoke** (RTX 4090): full megatron training (Qwen2.5-0.5B, `optimizer_offload=True` + `optimizer_cpu_offload=True`, fractions 1.0/0.5/0.0) — all three exit 0 (2 update steps each).

Note: building/stepping an HDO on megatron-core 0.16.1 hits a separate `Float16Optimizer` param-groups bug (a Megatron-LM issue, not this PR); the HDO test uses an all-bf16 model (matching verl's real `Float16Module` path) so it does not depend on that megatron fix.

### API and Usage Example

No API change. Existing `optimizer_offload` / `optimizer_cpu_offload` / `optimizer_offload_fraction` semantics are unchanged — the only difference is that HDO state is no longer moved to CPU (which was incorrect).

### Design & Code Changes

- `verl/utils/megatron_utils.py`, `offload_megatron_optimizer`: remove the unconditional HDO sub-optimizer state loop; HDO optimizers are now skipped entirely, and only non-HDO optimizers' `exp_avg/exp_avg_sq/master_param` are offloaded to CPU. `offload_megatron_copy_params` (params / fp32 master shards) is unchanged. `load_megatron_optimizer` is unchanged (it already delegates HDO state placement to `_move_new_state_to_right_device`).
- `tests/utils/megatron/test_optimizer_offload_and_load.py`: add HDO regression test (fractions 0.5/0.0).

### Checklist Before Submitting

- [x] Read the [Contribute Guide](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [x] Apply [pre-commit checks](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#code-linting-and-formatting): `pre-commit run --files verl/utils/megatron_utils.py tests/utils/megatron/test_optimizer_offload_and_load.py` — all hooks passed (ruff, mypy, doc/device/DataProto checks, license, naming, compile)
- [ ] Add / Update [the documentation](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/tree/main/docs): not needed — no user-facing API or config change
- [x] Add unit or e2e test(s) to [the CI workflow](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/tree/main/.github/workflows): regression test added alongside the existing megatron offload test. Note: that test file is currently excluded from the unit-test workflow (`--ignore-glob=*test_optimizer_offload_and_load.py*`) and requires CUDA + megatron; validated on an RTX 4090.
- [ ] Once your PR is ready for CI, send a message in [the `ci-request` channel](https://verl-project.slack.com/archives/C091TCESWB1) — draft; will do once tests complete and the PR is reviewed
- [ ] If your PR is related to the `recipe` submodule... — N/A

@@ -33,8 +33,12 @@
 SEQUENCE_LENGTH = 64
 
 
-def init_model():
-    """Initialize a small GPT model for the test, wrapped in Megatron DDP."""
+def init_model(bf16_all: bool = False):
+    """Initialize a small GPT model for the test, wrapped in Megatron DDP.
+
+    With ``bf16_all=True`` the model is cast to bf16 in place, matching verl's
+    real pipeline (megatron Float16Module) where every model param is bf16 and
+    the DistributedOptimizer's fp32 shards are leaf copies."""
 
     transformer_config = TransformerConfig(
         num_layers=2,
@@ -50,6 +54,8 @@ def init_model():
         vocab_size=128,
         max_sequence_length=SEQUENCE_LENGTH,
     ).cuda()
+    if bf16_all:
+        gpt_model.bfloat16()
 
     ddp_config = DistributedDataParallelConfig(use_distributed_optimizer=True)
     model_chunk = McoreDDP(transformer_config, ddp_config, gpt_model)
@@ -152,3 +158,94 @@ def test_precision_aware_optimizer_offload_and_load(tmp_path):
         # Tear down MPU state and torch.distributed.
         mpu.destroy_model_parallel()
         dist.destroy_process_group()
+
+
+def init_hdo_optimizer(model, fraction):
+    """Initialize a HybridDeviceOptimizer (HDO) with the given offload fraction."""
+
+    optimizer_config = OptimizerConfig(
+        optimizer="adam",
+        lr=1e-6,
+        min_lr=1e-6,
+        clip_grad=1.0,
+        weight_decay=0.0,
+        use_distributed_optimizer=True,
+        optimizer_cpu_offload=True,
+        optimizer_offload_fraction=fraction,
+        overlap_cpu_optimizer_d2h_h2d=True,
+        bf16=True,
+        params_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+    )
+    return get_megatron_optimizer(optimizer_config, model)
+
+
+def gpu_sub_optimizer_state_ids(optimizer):
+    """Collect (object id, device) of the GPU sub-optimizer's Adam-moment state
+    tensors (``exp_avg`` / ``exp_avg_sq``) of an HDO — the tensors that must
+    stay on GPU across offload (issue #8237). ``master_param`` is excluded
+    deliberately: it is a weight shard that ``offload_megatron_copy_params``
+    legitimately offloads."""
+
+    opts = optimizer.chained_optimizers if isinstance(optimizer, ChainedOptimizer) else [optimizer]
+    gpu_state = []
+    for opt in opts:
+        hdo = opt.optimizer
+        for sub in hdo.sub_optimizers:
+            for state in sub.state.values():
+                for k, v in state.items():
+                    if isinstance(v, torch.Tensor) and v.is_cuda and k in ("exp_avg", "exp_avg_sq"):
+                        gpu_state.append((id(v), str(v.device)))
+    return gpu_state
+
+
+def test_hdo_optimizer_offload_leaves_gpu_state_untouched(tmp_path):
+    """Regression test for https://github.com/verl-project/verl/issues/8237.
+
+    With optimizer_cpu_offload=True and optimizer_offload_fraction < 1, the
+    HDO's GPU sub-optimizer (FusedAdam) state must stay on GPU across
+    offload_megatron_optimizer: moving it to CPU corrupts its device assumption
+    and crashes the next fused step. Note: this test requires a Megatron-LM
+    version where building a HybridDeviceOptimizer and stepping it works (on
+    megatron-core 0.16.1, a separate Float16Optimizer param_groups bug blocks
+    the first HDO step)."""
+
+    rendezvous_file = tmp_path / "rdzv_hdo"
+
+    torch.cuda.set_device(0)
+    dist.init_process_group(
+        backend="cpu:gloo,cuda:nccl",
+        init_method=f"file://{rendezvous_file}",
+        rank=0,
+        world_size=1,
+    )
+    mpu.initialize_model_parallel()
+    model_parallel_cuda_manual_seed(123)
+
+    try:
+        for fraction in (0.5, 0.0):
+            model_chunks = init_model(bf16_all=True)
+            optimizer = init_hdo_optimizer(model_chunks, fraction)
+
+            # Fully initialize optimizer state via a step on zeroed grads.
+            for model_chunk in model_chunks:
+                model_chunk.zero_grad_buffer()
+            optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=False)
+            update_successful, _, _ = optimizer.step()
+            assert update_successful
+
+            # GPU sub-optimizer state must exist on GPU before offload.
+            gpu_state_before = gpu_sub_optimizer_state_ids(optimizer)
+            assert len(gpu_state_before) > 0
+
+            # offload must NOT touch the GPU sub-optimizer's state (issue #8237).
+            offload_megatron_optimizer(optimizer)
+            assert gpu_sub_optimizer_state_ids(optimizer) == gpu_state_before
+
+            # The round trip must still restore the state to GPU after load.
+            load_megatron_optimizer(optimizer)
+            assert len(gpu_sub_optimizer_state_ids(optimizer)) == len(gpu_state_before)
+            assert all(device == "cuda:0" for _, device in gpu_sub_optimizer_state_ids(optimizer))
+    finally:
+        # Tear down MPU state and torch.distributed.
+        mpu.destroy_model_parallel()
+        dist.destroy_process_group()

inline_comments.body: With `optimizer_offload_fraction < 1`, the HDO has a GPU-resident FusedAdam sub-optimizer whose state must stay on GPU. This line moves it to CPU, so either the next fused step reads CPU tensors (native crash, no traceback) or — when `master_param` is a view into `param_data` freed by the model offload earlier in the same phase switch — the `.to("cpu")` itself reads freed memory and raises `CUDA error: invalid argument` (issue #8237).
